summary: The cleanest names on the menu are VRSN (F-score 9, gp_sector_pct 0.993, cfo 1.09B vs net income 826M) and MSM (F-score 9, cfo 306.5M vs net income 222.6M), followed by CARG and SAM, where cash flow is well above earnings. No lesson in learning.json lists the Fundamentals Analyst in applies_to, and I have no graded calls, so none shaped the ranking. I did follow the L3 sector-label caution: several top-of-sector ranks (DPZ, FAST, MSM, MSCI, MCO, CART, HWM) rest on labels that look wrong, so I ranked on absolute quality, not on the sector rank. The menu is as of 2026-10-27, three days old, and several names have since reported or had deal news (RRC, CART, INCY, HWM, LNG, GRMN).
